$comment: AIA design system tokens, flat: name -> {light, dark, purpose}. 'alias' names the token a colour follows; density/mode tokens add 'compact'. CSS: ../tokens/tokens.css. Values from the AIA Design System artifact; apps/web/src/design/tokens.json is the implementation's source and agrees on every shared name.

surface.purpose: Page ground in Studio. Light: paper with a faint warm cast so eight-hour sessions do not glare. Dark: graphite. Every text token is verified against it.

surface-raised.purpose: Panels, table bodies, cards, the stage rail track. One step above `surface`; separated by `border`, never by shadow.

surface-sunken.purpose: Wells: table headers, inputs, code and fingerprint blocks, the budget meter track.

surface-overlay.purpose: Dialogs and popovers only (the park-and-ask dialog, command palette). Pairs with `shadow-overlay`.

border.purpose: Hairline dividers between rows, panels and cells. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

border-strong.purpose: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes) and the scope bar edge. >= 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

ink.purpose: Primary text and every figure a conclusion rests on. >= 7:1 (AA-plus) on all surfaces and status washes in both themes.

ink-muted.purpose: Secondary text: labels, metadata, table headers. >= 4.5:1 on surface, raised, sunken and overlay.

ink-faint.purpose: Tertiary text: timestamps, hints, NOT_STARTED stages. >= 4.5:1 on all four surfaces — faint, never illegible.

surface-inverse.purpose: Inverse fields: the RECOVERY_REQUIRED block, tooltips, the keyboard-shortcut overlay.

signal.purpose: The one precise accent: selection, links, the live edge of a RUNNING process, the primary action. Used sparingly — never decoration, never for a warning.

signal-wash.purpose: Selected row / selected stage background. `ink` stays >= 7:1 on it.

on-signal.purpose: Text and icons on a solid `signal` fill (primary button).

focus-ring.purpose: The 2px focus outline, always drawn with a 2px `surface` gap so it sits on a known ground; >= 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

status-running.purpose: RUNNING / EXECUTING: the machine is working, nothing is needed from you. Same hue as `signal` on purpose: the live edge.

status-running-wash.purpose: Background of a running row or stage cell.

status-you.purpose: RESERVED for "parked, waiting on a person" (WAITING_USER, AWAITING_GATE, AWAITING_BUDGET, WAITING_CREDITS). Solid fill, the loudest thing on any screen. Never used for anything else — not warnings, not highlights, not a data series.

on-status-you.purpose: Label and glyph on a solid `status-you` fill. >= 7:1.

status-you-ink.purpose: Waiting-on-you text and glyphs on ordinary surfaces (the count in the nav, an inline "čeká na vás").

status-you-wash.purpose: Row background for a parked-on-you item in Portfolio and run logs.

status-world.purpose: "Parked, waiting on the world": WAITING_PROVIDER, WAITING_CAPACITY. Slate — calm, not alarming, visibly not running.

status-world-wash.purpose: Row background for a waiting-on-the-world item.

status-fault.purpose: FAILED and SCHEMA/PERMISSION failure text and glyphs; the uncertain part of the budget meter. Always with the × glyph and a label.

status-fault-wash.purpose: Row background for a failed item.

status-recovery.purpose: RECOVERY_REQUIRED block fill: inverse ink. The rarest, most serious state — a decision about money that may already be spent.

status-recovery-hatch.purpose: The 45-degree hatch band along the recovery block edge. >= 3:1 against `status-recovery`.

status-done.purpose: DONE / COMPLETED / SUCCEEDED glyph: plain ink. Done is quiet, not celebratory — there is no green in the status family.

status-inert.purpose: NOT_STARTED, BLOCKED, CANCELLED, SKIPPED, INVALIDATED glyphs and labels.

viz-cat-1.purpose: Categorical series slot 1 (blue). Fixed order, never cycled. Plot area only.

viz-cat-2.purpose: Categorical slot 2 (orange). Light theme 2.97:1 on surface: charts always carry direct labels or a table view (relief rule).

viz-cat-3.purpose: Categorical slot 3 (aqua). Light 2.61:1: relief rule applies.

viz-cat-6.purpose: Categorical slot 6 (magenta). Light 2.50:1: relief rule. A seventh series folds into "Ostatní" or small multiples.

viz-seq-1.purpose: Sequential ramp step 1 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

viz-seq-2.purpose: Sequential ramp step 2 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

viz-seq-3.purpose: Sequential ramp step 3 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

viz-seq-4.purpose: Sequential ramp step 4 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

viz-seq-5.purpose: Sequential ramp step 5 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

viz-seq-6.purpose: Sequential ramp step 6 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

viz-seq-7.purpose: Sequential ramp step 7 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

viz-div-4.purpose: Diverging midpoint — neutral grey, never a hue, step 4 of 7.

client-1.purpose: Client accent (rose). Scope chrome only: the scope-bar band and the client monogram. Never on data, never on status.

on-client.purpose: Monogram letters on a client accent tile. >= 4.5:1 on all six in both themes.

doc-paper.purpose: Deliverable register page. Identical in both themes: the report is paper even when the Studio is dark.

doc-rule.purpose: Report table rules and figure frames.

doc-accent.purpose: Report section numbers and the cover rule. The only colour a printed report needs; prints as dark grey.

evidence-mark.purpose: Evidence-grade marks (the grade glyph, dashed/dotted underlines, hollow nodes). Achromatic by design so the grade survives greyscale print and never collides with status or data colour.

evidence-hatch.purpose: Hatch strokes for modelled bars and cells.

null-mark.purpose: The "not available" glyph and label. Full ink: missing data is information, never softer than a bad value.

suppressed-fill.purpose: The solid redaction bar of a suppressed value.

budget-spent.purpose: Settled spend segment of the budget meter.

budget-uncertain.purpose: SETTLED_UNCERTAIN segment: money that may already be gone. Hatched and labelled, never rounded into spent.

scope-above.purpose: The band of a cross-client surface (Portfolio, Admin): hatched ink instead of a client accent — you are above the boundary.

selection.purpose: Alias of `signal-wash` for selected rows, nodes and text ranges.

font-sans.purpose: UI face: IBM Plex Sans (tabular figures by default). Studio text, numbers, report tables and captions.

font-mono.purpose: Identifier face: IBM Plex Mono. Fingerprints, revision, run, step and ledger ids; use with font-feature-settings "zero" 1.

font-serif.purpose: Deliverable prose: Source Serif 4. Report body, chapter and section headings, footnotes.

font-display.purpose: Deliverable cover: Source Serif 4 Display. The report cover title only.

text-studio-title.purpose: Page title: study or screen name. One per screen.

text-studio-body.purpose: Default UI text in comfortable density.

text-studio-body-compact.purpose: Dense tables: respondent explorer, usage ledger, run log.

text-studio-label.purpose: Status chip labels, field labels, table headers. Sentence case, never all caps (Czech diacritics collide with caps height).

text-studio-caption.purpose: Metadata and timestamps. 12px is the floor: nothing in AIA is set smaller.

text-num.purpose: Every compared number. Plex Sans figures are tabular by default (all digits 600 units): columns align without a feature flag.

text-num-hero.purpose: The one figure of a headline answer or a budget meter total.

text-mono.purpose: Identifiers: fingerprints, revision ids, run and step ids, ledger row ids. Slashed zero on (font-feature-settings "zero").

text-mono-sm.purpose: Identifiers inside compact tables and the run log.

text-doc-title.purpose: Report cover title. Display optical size.

text-doc-lede.purpose: The headline answer paragraph on the report page.

text-doc-caption.purpose: Figure and table captions: always name n and the evidence grade.

font-feature-mono.purpose: Slashed zero for every mono identifier.

space-half.purpose: Glyph-to-label gap inside chips; gaps between stacked meter segments.

space-1.purpose: Icon padding; compact cell vertical padding.

space-2.purpose: Cell horizontal padding; gap between chips.

radius-0.purpose: Tables, the stage rail, the scope bar, report figures. Precision reads square.

radius-sm.purpose: Chips, inputs, buttons, cells with a state fill.

radius-md.purpose: Panels, dialogs, popovers. The largest radius in the system.

stroke-emphasis.purpose: Chart lines, the focus ring, the selected-stage underline.

stroke-scope.purpose: The client accent band of the scope bar.

shadow-overlay.purpose: Dialogs and popovers only. Everything else is flat and bordered.

z-scope.purpose: The scope bar: above all page content, it must never scroll away or be covered.

z-toast.purpose: Transient confirmations. Never used for a parked or failed state — those live in the page.

duration-confirm.purpose: State-change confirmation: a chip changing status, a row selected. Motion confirms a transition that happened; it never anticipates one.

row-compact.purpose: Row height in compact density: respondent explorer, usage ledger, run log.

row-comfortable.purpose: Row height in comfortable density: Portfolio, Admin lists.

control-compact.purpose: Button and input height in compact density.

control-comfortable.purpose: Button and input height in comfortable density. Hit area never below 24px (WCAG 2.2 target size).

row-height.purpose: Table/list row height in the current density: comfortable (Portfolio, Admin, prose) or compact (respondent explorer, usage ledger, run log).

control-height.purpose: Button and input height in the current density; never below 24px (WCAG 2.2 target size).

text-density-body.purpose: Body text in the current density: 14/20 comfortable, 13/18 compact.

text-density-num.purpose: Compared numbers in the current density: 14/20 comfortable, 13/18 compact.
